{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows to understand structure
display(trial.head())

# Show data types and missing values
display(trial.info())

# Check unique values in likely columns for baseline disease severity
# Look for columns with 'severity', 'grade', 'stage', 'level', 'baseline' in name
possible_cols = [col for col in trial.columns if any(keyword in col.lower() for keyword in ['severity', 'grade', 'stage', 'level', 'baseline'])]
print("Possible columns for baseline disease severity:", possible_cols)

# Check unique values in those columns
for col in possible_cols:
    print(f"\nUnique values in {col}:")
    print(trial[col].unique())"}
